  Produce the reproduction plan for this paper exactly per your agent brief and the output schema. Set paper_slug to "herskind-riede-2024". Key instrument_versions and instrument_receipts by exactly these pushed-instrument names: data-availability-taxonomy, coverage-rules, eligibility-criteria, pipeline-invariants. In pulled_files_read list bare file paths only — no versions, tokens, or comments in the string.
  Registrant rulings (apply to every paper): R1 No author code: a target whose published result has no supplied code may be tested with clearly labelled verification aids. Aids are read-only lookups in the deposited data, and calls to documented functions of the package the authors used. They make no new statistical choices, and they live in a separate comparison script, never in the authors' code. A difference caused only by an unpublished convention (for example histogram bin edges) is MINOR_DISCREPANCY. R2 Unavailable inputs: a target whose inputs cannot be obtained stays in the locked denominator as expected-untestable and counts against coverage. Never drop it to narrow scope. R3 Granularity: one target per display item. A multi-panel figure is one target, and its panels are described within it. Named values in the text are separate targets. R4 Internal inconsistency: where the paper's text and its own tables or figures disagree, score against the stated value. Apply the PAPER_ERROR protocol if the reproduction disagrees, and escalate.
